title.zh: 把信号复制到另一个地址
title.en: Copy a Signal to Another Address

brief.zh: 把地址 0 的信号复制到地址 2，保留其他内存值。给同一份程序换一组输入试试。
brief.en: Copy the signal from address 0 to address 2 and preserve the other values. Try the same program with different input.

concept.zh: LOAD 读源地址，STORE 写目标地址。
concept.en: LOAD reads the source address and STORE writes the destination.

hints.zh: 选择地址 0，添加 LOAD。再选地址 2，添加 STORE。HALT 会让 CPU 结束工作。
hints.en: Choose address 0 and add LOAD. Choose address 2 and add STORE. HALT ends the program.
